title: Veterans Pension Net Worth — Monthly Care Figure From Reported Care Months
content:
The monthly care figure for Veterans Pension net worth follows the care months reported — the medical expense reports received on the award in the 3 whole months before the redetermination, one care month each:

> With at least 3 care months reported and the most recent month above the average of the reported months, the most recent month is the monthly figure; with at least 3 care months reported and the most recent month at or below that average, the average rounded to the cent is the monthly figure; otherwise the total reported stands in its place.

The most recent month is the care month whose expense period starts latest.

### Examples (hypothetical)

1. Reported 2000.00, 2100.00, 2600.00, the most recent 2600.00; average 2233.33. Above the average: monthly figure 2600.00.
2. Reported 2600.00, 2100.00, 2000.00, the most recent 2000.00; average 2233.33. At or below: monthly figure 2233.33.
3. Reported 2400.00 only: fewer than 3 months; the total, 2400.00, stands in its place.
